title: Hanz's Order

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: You. What is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You. What is it?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: I don't have time for shilly-shallying. Spit it out or walk on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have time for shilly-shallying. Spit it out or walk on.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Filling in? Are you good? You had better be good. My clients demand the best.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Filling in? Are you good? You had better be good. My clients demand the best.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Beef.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Beef.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Beef. That’s what I need. Customer requested steak, medium rare. Special order. Very important client.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Beef. That’s what I need. Customer requested steak, medium rare. Special order. Very important client.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text:
It's the new rhyme-based Spire diet. Everything has to rhyme with “awake”.
I was considering Shiitake, but the client is allergic to mushrooms.

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
It's the new rhyme-based Spire diet. Everything has to rhyme with “awake”.
I was considering Shiitake, but the client is allergic to mushrooms.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Shut up! Don’t let them hear you! Anyway, can you deliver?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shut up! Don’t let them hear you! Anyway, can you deliver?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: You think these guests, whose palates have been refined to detect the slightest trace of saline, would accept just any meat? They would riot! No, it must be fresh, juicy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think these guests, whose palates have been refined to detect the slightest trace of saline, would accept just any meat? They would riot! No, it must be fresh, juicy.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: How does it even grow? Underground cattle farms? I have no idea. But beef I need and now is when I need it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How does it even grow? Underground cattle farms? I have no idea. But beef I need and now is when I need it.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: I don’t care what it costs! If you grow it you can name your price. What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t care what it costs! If you grow it you can name your price. What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: You will be paid of course. 200 Lims should cover it, yes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You will be paid of course. 200 Lims should cover it, yes?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Theft and robbery.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Theft and robbery.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: 500. My final offer. Take it or leave it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 500. My final offer. Take it or leave it.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: It already happened. We deal with it. With blancmange.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It already happened. We deal with it. With blancmange.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: I am done with this chatter!! Beef is what I need and now is when I need it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am done with this chatter!! Beef is what I need and now is when I need it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm here from the Greenhouses. Filling in for Clem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm here from the Greenhouses. Filling in for Clem.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm here from the Greenhouses. Filling in for Clem.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm here from the Greenhouses. Filling in for Clem.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bit rude...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bit rude...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Here about a farming order?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here about a farming order?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then they'll get the best. What do you need?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then they'll get the best. What do you need?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Then they'll get the best. What do you need?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Then they'll get the best. What do you need?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Doesn't seem like you have a choice. What do you need?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn't seem like you have a choice. What do you need?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Doesn't seem like you have a choice. What do you need?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Doesn't seem like you have a choice. What do you need?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't you mean Shiitáke?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't you mean Shiitáke?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why don’t you just buy the beef?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why don’t you just buy the beef?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why don’t you just buy the beef?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why don’t you just buy the beef?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Beef. Got it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Beef. Got it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Leave it with me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Leave it with me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Beef is tricky. This will cost you…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Beef is tricky. This will cost you…
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Beef is tricky. This will cost you…
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Beef is tricky. This will cost you…

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Make it 1000 Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Make it 1000 Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You want that beef?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want that beef?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happens when your clients ask for something that rhymes with "orange"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happens when your clients ask for something that rhymes with "orange"?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What happens when your clients ask for something that rhymes with "orange"?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What happens when your clients ask for something that rhymes with "orange"?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But blancmange...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But blancmange...
